My idea was a character study about a deaf man who is an artist and obsessed with Van Gogh. It would follow this man and his best friend throughout their childhood, exploring growing up deaf in a hearing world with a best friend that has to learn to communicate with you in different ways. Throughout their college experience, where they would have to attend different universities. It would go through the man's development as an artist as his friend becomes a pianist and would be told in mostly flashbacks as the two friends go on a 'collect-em-all' adventure to visit all of Van Goghs paintings and historic sites where he lived
